note: Same error type as a rate limit and the same status, but no retry-after and waiting does not help. Told apart by error.details.error_code. Classified as an error rather than as congestion, because backing off cannot fix a spend cap and a controller that treats it as congestion collapses the limit for a condition it can never clear.

error.message: You have reached your API usage limits: your organization has crossed its monthly API usage threshold, set based on your organization's API tier. You will regain access on 2026-09-01 at 00:00 UTC.
